response.overview: Two characters, in conflict, in a room is a tried and true formula of low budget filmmaking but in his short 15 Before the 3rd, Jamie Winterstern subverts that standard to raise the steaks and give us something all the more tense than the norm. Jamie joins us to discuss his jump from intimate short to the commercial calling card film.
response.tagline: 15 minutes before the 3rd period – a coach calls upon his rookie.
response.title: 15 Before the 3rd
